sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant No.1 Nafees is the husband of Smt. Malka Praveen daughter of opposite party No.2.

It is further submitted that on account of ill will, the present case was lodged under sections 498A, 323, 504 and 506 I.P.C and 3/4 D.P Act, by the opposite party No.2 against the applicant and other members of his family in which after investigation the charge sheet was filed by the Investigating Officer against applicants.
It is further submitted that the applicant No.1 Nafees is living with Smt. Malka Parveen amicably and there are three children from the wedlock.

Now there is no any dispute between the parties, so to prosecute the applicant and other members of his family will be misuse of process of the court, therefore,
request to quash the entire proceedings of the case in view of the fact that the applicant No.1 is living with his wife amicably and there is no any dispute between both of them.
It is also submitted that a copy of settlement between the parties was also filed with this application which is on record.
Learned A.G.A has no objection in this regard.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicants, learned A.G.A, perusal of record and the fact that the present case was registered by the father of Smt. Malaka Praveen, the wife of applicant No.1 Nafees and both of them are living as husband and wife amicably with their children.
There is no any dispute between both of them and they are willing to end this case on the basis of compromise between the husband and his wife.

In view of the aforesaid facts it is expedient and in the interest of justice to direct the applicant No.1 Nafees and his wife Smt. Malka Praveen to appear and file an application with affidavit in this regard before the learned trial court within a period of 30 days from today and the learned trial court is to verify the contents of the application and then the parties may file certified copy thereof before this Court with fresh application.
Accordingly, this application is disposed of finally.

Order Date :- 9.9.2024 G.S  Nafees And Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 9 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/116996556/
